expectedFindings.description: `removeIndexString` runs after path params are substituted, so a param whose value is "index" (e.g. `/docs/:page` with `page: 'index'`) is stripped and `$url()` returns `/docs`. `fetch` already strips before substituting.

evidence.note: Fix PR: "This is a follow-up to #4267, which added the removeIndexString call ... and placed it at the end of the sequence". Moves it ahead of param substitution.
